features: 4+10 Upgraded Storage Capacity – Featuring 4 spacious compartments, 2 transparent PVC pockets on top, and 8 mesh side pockets, our newly launched over the door organizer offers all-in-one neat storage for everything from bulky household items like clothes, blankets, wipes, and plush toys to small, easily misplaced essentials such as hair ties and Bluetooth earbuds. This latest 5 tier door hanging organizer boasts expanded layers with over double the width and spacing, allowing you to keep everything within easy reach and perfectly organized. 48”(Height) X 14”(Width) X 5.5”(Deep)

Clear Windows, Effortless Access - This enhanced version of Yecaye over door organizers has incorporated transparent PVC panels that reveal contents instantly. Never again struggle to find cotton swabs, chargers or socks - your essentials remain perfectly visible and within reach. More than just storage, its contemporary aesthetic elevates the door organizer into an eye-catching display. Showcase plush toys, craft supplies or treasured keepsakes while keeping your space tidy and visually appealing.

Premium Farbic, Reinforced Frame - Our over the door storage organizer are made of breathable, thickened non-woven fabric that is skin-friendly and eco-friendly, offering exceptional support and durability to maintain their shape without sagging or deformation during longtime use. Engineered for home essentials, reinforced stitching and heavy-duty double-layered fabric guarantee secure behind the door storage for heavier items. Fits doors 1¼" to 1¾'' thick.

Versatile for Every Room - Whether it's a cramped small bedroom, an overcrowded wardrobe, a busy kitchen where you can barely turn around, or even a cramped bathroom corner or a laundry room with no space to stand, our multi-functional door hanging organizer can magically create unexpected storage space for you. You’ll find out that the previously wasted space behind doors can effortlessly accommodate the ease and comfort of everyday life.

Instant Clutter Fix Hanging Organizer in 30 Secs - No tools or drilling required, just hang it up. Yecaye door hanging organizer makes storage easier than ever! Say goodbye to tedious drilling and wall damage, renters and DIY novices can do it with ease. Whether it's a dorm room, apartment, or a corner of your home, no major renovations are needed—just hang it up and you're good to go. Package includes: 5-tier door organizer * 1, Metal Support Hook * 2, Bottom Support Carboard * 4, Side Support Carboard * 2.
